    train_unique = train_df[col].unique()
    test_unique = test_df[col].unique()
    # Get mapping based on sorted train values
    train_val_map = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(sorted(train_unique))}

    X_train[f"{col}_encoded"] = X_train[col].map(train_val_map)
    X_test[f"{col}_encoded"] = X_test[col].map(train_val_map)

X_encoded = X_train[["f_27_encoded"]].copy() if categorical_cols else X_train.copy()
if categorical_cols:
    X_encoded[numeric_cols] = X_train[numeric_cols]
    X_test_encoded = X_test[
        [col for col in numeric_cols if col in X_test.columns]
    ].copy()
else:

    X_test_encoded = X_test

)
